spec.description:
Foilboard Standard Tek Screws are self-drilling, zinc-plated
steel screws pre-fitted with broad spreader washers, designed to secure
Foilboard panels to light-gauge steel framing (up to 2.5mm steel thickness). The
self-drilling drill-point tip pierces steel girts and studs without
pre-drilling, while the broad washer head distributes clamping force across the
panel face. Sized for 10mm to 25mm Foilboard sheets, they ensure rigid panel
fixing in steel-framed sheds, commercial drywall, and residential steel homes.
features:
Self-drilling hardened drill-point tip for fast fixing into
light-gauge steel framing

Pre-fitted with broad spreader washer to distribute
load and prevent foil tear-through

Corrosion-resistant zinc-plated coating
compliant with Australian building standards

Designed specifically for 10mm
to 25mm Foilboard panels on steel framing up to 2.5mm thick

Hex-head or
wafer-head drive prevents cam-out and speeds installation

Eliminates the need
for pre-drilling holes through steel studs or girts

Provides tight mechanical
clamping without crushing the expanded polystyrene core

technical.value:
Self-drilling steel tek
screw with integrated broad washer plate

0.75 mm to 2.5 mm steel stud / girt
thickness

spec.fire:
Non-combustible steel fastener; compliant with NCC fire hazard
requirements
spec.compliance: AS 3566, AS/NZS 4859.1, NCC Volume One and Two
install:
Hold
Foilboard panel firmly against steel studs or purlins

Fit Foilboard Standard
Tek Screw into screw gun or drill driver with matching bit

Drive screw
perpendicular through the panel and into the steel framing member

Allow drill
tip to penetrate steel stud before applying driving torque

Stop driving when
the broad washer head seats flush and firm against the aluminum foil facing
Do not overtighten to avoid dishing the washer into the EPS core

Space
screws at maximum 600mm centers along perimeter and internal framing members

Seal over screw heads with Foilboard 72mm reinforced foil tape if an airtight
vapor seal is required
selection_checklist:
Confirm framing is steel
(0.75mm to 2.5mm thickness)

Select screw length matching board thickness
(board thickness + minimum 15-20mm steel penetration)

Calculate total screw
count based on approx. 6-8 screws per standard sheet

Order matching 72mm
reinforced foil tape to seal over fastener heads
limitations:
Not suitable for heavy structural steel thicker
than 2.5mm without pre-drilling

Do not overtighten; excessive torque will
strip light-gauge steel or crush board

For thick boards (40mm to 50mm), use
Foilboard Ultra Tek Screws

Installing rigid foil boards on commercial steel drywall partitions
